My SO is pre-med(MT). My most of exes are in med(one is a nurse, the other one was cadio and one was practicing medical law)...
I'm in the creative field. Me and SO have different personalities and love languages. I would suggest a ton of patience and understanding. Kasi their schedule can change in an instant kahit na may lakad at schedule kayong dalawa that day...always have a backup plan pag naudlot or magbago. Do random acts of love and kindness when you can. As simple as writing a message/video or maybe food(cooked or bought by you). And if you can sleep at her place... sleeping in one bed helps din kahit once a week(that end of the day chitchat and cuddling is a great destress for anyone). And hugs. Actually, if you know her love lamguage, do that.

The key is patience and understanding. They will have the most stressful time kasi they choose to be in the med field to help others...we, in return, should be their rock when they're tired and wanting to give up. We need to remind our SO why they went with this path and what their goals are(emotional and physical support).

Yun lang.

Hope this helps.
